title: tetrorchidium minus
intro: Tetrorchidium minus, commonly known as the "Yellow Cardamom", is a species of plant in the family Euphorbiaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin infections, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Tetrorchidium minus include reducing inflammation, relieving pain, and treating wounds, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, terpenoids, and alkaloids. These constituents also contribute to its antioxidant, antiseptic, and antiviral activities, making Tetrorchidium minus a valuable plant in traditional medicine.
